title: Royal Duke water and cooling attack-surface model
scope: Isolated defensive cyber-range simulation. No production endpoints or credentials.

fidelity.note: The S7 engineering surface models trust, asset context, and controller authority. It is not Siemens firmware and does not expose an S7 listener.

assets.label: Vendor access broker
assets.role: Creates an attributable, expiring maintenance session

assets.label: Engineering workstation
assets.role: Holds the controller project, station identity, and approved change path

assets.label: Operator / protocol gateway
assets.role: Polls Modbus process data, projects the operator view, and serves DNP3 points

assets.label: Water process PLC
assets.role: Runs pump, pressure, flow, alarm, and optional safety-interlock logic

assets.label: Cooling water process
assets.role: Converts pump state into pressure, flow, and low-pressure alarms

surfaces.requiredAuthority: approved maintenance identity and active session
controller project context, station trust, and program/write mode
gateway message-bus update mapped to an allowed coil or register
isolated supervisory-network access; control uses select-before-operate

actions.label: Establish vendor maintenance session
actions.effect: A valid remote session exists; it grants no controller authority by itself.

actions.label: Resolve the engineering path
actions.effect: The session can reach the engineering enclave through the approved broker path.

actions.label: Acquire controller project context
actions.effect: Station identity, controller family, project mapping, and permitted change operation are known.

actions.label: Poison the defensive evidence stream
actions.effect: An attacker-controlled maintenance note attempts to steer defensive AI toward SENSOR_FAULT and away from containment.
actions.evidence: vendor session note, evidence provenance, Model Armor verdict

actions.label: Freeze the operator pressure view
actions.effect: The gateway holds the displayed pressure at 62 PSI while independent process telemetry remains live.

actions.label: Change the pump command
actions.effect: An allowlisted gateway update crosses live Modbus TCP and de-energizes the simulated pump.
actions.evidence: gateway update, Modbus coil write, PLC state transition

actions.label: Attempt another controller write
actions.effect: The attacker retries the affected write path after containment; the range records the denial without touching process state.

actions.label: Observe low-pressure consequence
actions.effect: The model records a physical consequence only after simulated pressure crosses the alarm threshold.
actions.evidence: independent process pressure and alarm point

controls.validates: project read and controller change authority
approved tag, value, origin, and maintenance window
minimum-pressure invariant independent of operator view

brand.title: Royal Duke: Attack the Agent
brand.thesis: A defensive AI fleet that can be deceived and partially compromised without surrendering authority.
brand.mapCredit: Loudoun data centers: public OSM centroids. Royal Duke HQ, water, and vendor sites are a fictional scenario overlay.

titleSequence.subtitle: A guided attack against an industrial process and the defensive AI fleet protecting it.
titleSequence.credit: The process is executable OT simulation. Royal Duke and its operational sites are fictional.

scenes.title: Normal operations
scenes.subtitle: P-101 holds the cooling process at its approved operating state before the guided attack begins.
log: P-101 discharge holds at 62.0 PSI.
The operator view agrees with independent telemetry.
No model output has operational authority.

scenes.title: Trusted vendor session
scenes.subtitle: An attributable vendor session enters the approved remote-access path; identity alone grants no controller authority.
log: A vendor maintenance identity is accepted.
The session is attributable and recordable.
Reachability is only the first gate.

scenes.title: Engineering context acquired
scenes.subtitle: The session reaches the engineering enclave and acquires the station and controller-project context required for a meaningful change.
log: The brokered route reaches the engineering enclave.
Station identity and controller project context are known.
The attacker now understands the defensive architecture.

scenes.title: Attack the defender
scenes.subtitle: A hostile instruction is inserted into attacker-controlled session evidence before the physical process is changed.
log: Attacker-controlled evidence instructs the AI to report SENSOR_FAULT.
The Shadow Analyst receives the raw instruction.
The authoritative path must establish provenance before trusting content.

scenes.title: Operator view frozen
scenes.subtitle: The HMI is held at 62 PSI, creating the false view that will conceal the next controller change.
log: The operator display is frozen at 62.0 PSI.
Independent process telemetry is still authoritative.
The lie exists before the process begins to fall.

scenes.title: P-101 de-energized
scenes.subtitle: A bounded Modbus write de-energizes P-101; independent pressure begins diverging while the 15-second incident predicate accumulates.
log: The process controller reports P-101 de-energized.
Operator and independent pressure differ by more than 5 PSI.
Deterministic evidence—not Gemini—must remain true for 15 seconds.

scenes.title: Authority holds
scenes.subtitle: The Shadow Analyst is fooled, but Model Armor quarantines the hostile evidence and compiled actions preserve evidence and contain the remote path.
log: The Shadow Analyst follows the hostile SENSOR_FAULT instruction.
The authoritative fleet quarantines that evidence and continues from physical truth.
A follow-up controller write is denied by the contained path.

scenes.title: The machine stops
scenes.subtitle: Pressure has crossed the low threshold. The fleet prepares restoration, but only the duty plant operator may authorize P-101 to energize.
log: Independent pressure is below 52 PSI.
Evidence is preserved and the remote path is contained.
P-101 restoration waits for a signed duty-operator approval assertion.

scenes.title: Physics answers
scenes.subtitle: After authorized restoration, independent pressure must remain above 58 PSI for 30 continuous seconds before the incident may close.
log: A signed approval authorizes the bounded restore_pump capability.
Independent pressure rises above 58 PSI.
Recovery remains open until the 30-second deterministic window passes.

scenes.title: Authority survived
scenes.subtitle: The process has recovered, the event chain verifies, and the reporter produces a cited content-addressed incident bundle.
log: VERIFY passes only after 30 stable seconds above 58 PSI.
Every report claim resolves to canonical evidence IDs.
The plan did not survive contact with the enemy. Authority did.

scenes.title: Recovery failed
scenes.subtitle: Independent pressure did not satisfy the recovery predicate. The fleet cannot call the incident resolved and escalates to the plant emergency procedure.
log: The 30-second recovery predicate did not pass.
No model recommendation can rewrite the failed physical observation.
The compiled workflow escalates to the plant emergency procedure.

responseSteps.title: Declare by predicate
responseSteps.detail: Independent and operator pressure differ by more than 5 PSI for 15 continuous seconds.

responseSteps.title: Quarantine hostile evidence
responseSteps.detail: Model Armor match or uncertain provenance excludes the session note from authoritative reasoning.

responseSteps.title: Preserve and contain
responseSteps.detail: Preserve the privileged session and block additional writes from the affected access path.

responseSteps.title: Restore P-101
responseSteps.detail: The duty plant operator must sign the exact restoration assertion before a grant can be minted.

responseSteps.title: Verify recovery
responseSteps.detail: Independent pressure remains above 58 PSI for 30 continuous seconds.

evidence.text: Normal pressure established at 62 PSI from operator and independent sources.
Broker destination and controller-project access establish the engineering path.
Hostile instruction is bound to attacker-controlled session evidence.
Operator pressure is held while independent telemetry remains live.
Controller state confirms P-101 de-energized and the 15-second divergence predicate fires.
Evidence is quarantined, session evidence preserved, and the affected write path contained.
Follow-up write denial and low-pressure evidence support a bounded restoration request.
Signed approval and independent recovery measurements accumulate.
Verification, event-chain, trace, provenance, and report hashes pass.
Failed recovery measurements and escalation state remain preserved as the terminal outcome.
